baseline.description: No change: keep the current setup
baseline.variant_facts:
The merchandise under consideration is a Electric stove heater. A household electric heater with a heating element, an electric motor driving a fan, a PCB, a metal housing and wiring, switches and connectors. The Electric stove heater is assembled in China using components sourced from Thailand and China.

The heating element (calibrated resistance wire) and printed circuit board (PCB) are produced in Thailand. The electric motor, fan, metal housing and wiring, switches and connectors are produced in China. 

Final assembly in China: install the heating element and PCB with fasteners and electrical connections; wire the unit and mount the fan and motor; install the housing and pack the finished heater.

key_factors: The combination of the electric motor, fan, metal housing, and final assembly operations.
prediction.decisive_step: Production of the motor, fan, and metal housing combined with final assembly in China.
prediction.reasoning: While the heating element and PCB are made in Thailand, China produces the electric motor, fan, metal housing, wiring, and switches, and performs the final assembly. Unlike simple screwdriver assembly of entirely foreign parts, the Chinese operations include manufacturing key functional and structural components (motor, fan, housing) and integrating them with the Thai components. Under the totality of the circumstances (similar to N357771 and N347272), the components become a new article of commerce in China.

plans.variant_facts:
The merchandise under consideration is a Electric stove heater. A household electric heater with a heating element, an electric motor driving a fan, a PCB, a metal housing and wiring, switches and connectors. The Electric stove heater is assembled in China using components sourced from Thailand and China.

The heating element (calibrated resistance wire), printed circuit board (PCB), electric motor and fan are produced in Thailand. The metal housing and wiring, switches and connectors are produced in China. 

In Thailand, the electric motor and fan will be produced in-house: stamp rotor laminations from silicon steel; stack laminations and wind the rotor; build the stator; assemble the motor; press-fit the fan to the motor spindle (assumed from the product-family template; no operations were supplied for this group).

Final assembly in China: install the heating element and PCB with fasteners and electrical connections; wire the unit and mount the fan and motor; install the housing and pack the finished heater.

key_factors: Heating element, electric motor, fan, and PCB
prediction.decisive_step: Manufacturing of the core functional components (electric motor, fan, heating element, and PCB) in Thailand
prediction.reasoning: Consistent with CBP precedent for electric heating appliances (e.g., N357771 and N328954), the essential character of the electric stove heater is imparted by its core functional components: the heating element, electric motor, fan, and PCB, which are all produced in Thailand. The final assembly in China—installing these key subassemblies into a Chinese metal housing with wiring and switches—constitutes simple assembly that does not substantially transform the Thai components.

verdict.reasoning: In N345859 (electric garage heater), N347396 (electric fireplace), and N357771 (heat gun), CBP consistently held that the heating element, electric motor, fan, and control electronics/PCBA collectively impart the essential character and basic nature of electric fan-forced heating appliances, while metal housing fabrication and simple final assembly merely enclose the components and do not effect a substantial transformation. In Variant A, the motor, fan, housing, and assembly are in China (origin China). In Variant B, moving the electric motor and fan to Thailand places all key functional components (heating element, PCB, motor, fan) in Thailand, shifting origin to Thailand.
